Definition: to expand, i.e. be great or (figuratively) magnificent
BiblicalUsage: To be great, glorious, majestic — adar appears three times, all of them praise. "Thy right hand, O LORD, is become glorious in power"; "who is like thee, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders"; and "he will magnify the law, and make it honourable." The word is a song, not a definition.
TheologicalSignificance: God's glory is not decoration; it is His power and His holiness on display. I hold those three verses together as the whole of it: glorious in power, glorious in holiness, and glorifying His own law.
RelatedTopics: Majesty of God; God's Holiness; God's Power
